text:
kai: Heads-up — I'm seeing a 25-40% token throughput regression on SM90 for the FlashX hybrid kernels when paged KV + auto-batching are enabled. Root perf run id 1880012345. Repro steps below.

marta: ugh. which model + seq len? :eyes:

kai: gpt-neox-like, seq 2048, batch mix mostly 1-4 but tail of 16. Regression shows up when cached KV is warm and the batcher aggregates across prefixes. On SM80 baseline (CUDA 12.1 + tuned CUDA kernels) perf is fine.

sam: can you paste the perf profile? nsys or nvprof slice?

kai: pasted a trimmed nsys slice: 
```
Time(ms)  Kernel                 GPU
12.3      flashx_triton_forward   SM90
9.1       flash_fused_attn        SM80
... total tokens/sec drop: 680 -> 420
```

marta: looks like the selector chooses the triton flashx kernel on SM90; might be higher occupancy but worse memory access pattern for paged KV. register pressure changes too.

jen: did you run with paged KV enabled and fused_paged toggled? there are two different codepaths.

kai: tested both. paged=true + fused_paged=false reproduces the regression. fused_paged=true falls back to an emulated slower path, so also bad.

omar: my suspicion: Triton kernels are getting prioritized because of an older compile cache throughput estimate; our CUDA kernels on SM80 had additional heuristics baked in. we need to inspect the selector heuristics.

devon: can you force kernel=force_cuda or force_triton to bisect?

kai: yes — forcing CUDA on SM90 recovered tokens/sec to ~600. So selector default (prefer triton auto) is the culprit. Config snippet used: 
```
selector:
  prefer_triton: auto
  heuristics:
    seq_threshold: 1024
    batch_ratio: 0.7
```

marta: maybe CUDA 12.3 / driver differences changed the relative perf; cost model no longer accurate on SM90. we should log sampled kernel latencies to telemetry and make selector adaptive.

sam: short-term fix: lower prefer_triton priority for SM90 in runtime until we refresh the kernel perf DB.

kai: I ran a microbench (single-kernel avg lat):
```
SM80 flash_fused_attn: 0.75ms
SM90 flashx_triton: 0.92ms
SM90 flashx_cuda: 0.78ms
```
So selector picks triton due to an optimistic throughput estimate. We need to update the estimator to include warp occupancy delta and explicit paged-KV stride cost.

jen: filing a perf ticket and will add a canary rollout that pins to CUDA for customers on SM90 until we have a selector fix.

perf-bot: created PERF-4321 "selector: SM90 prefers triton yields regressions with paged KV" assigned to eng-runtime

omar: also add a small benchmark harness in CI to run seq=2048 with batch shape mix (1,2,4,8,16) across both kernels and CUDA versions. we should fail the build on regressions >10%.

devon: note: the batching heuristic currently merges across prefixes which increases effective batch sizes when cache is hot. we should cap cross-prefix aggregation when pagedKV is enabled or implement a kv-aware grouping key.

kai: agreed. I'll prototype a "kv-aware" batching policy that tracks prefix-id and prefers same-prefix grouping. will post a patch and perf numbers.

sam: thanks — if someone wants to triage traces tomorrow ping me and I'll help with nsys flame graphs.

kai: uploaded traces to /shared/perf/1880012345/ (nsys + triton logs).
